task.title: Recover and ship Build 51 HealthKit regression fix

result.summary: Recovered and validated the interrupted Build 51 HealthKit fix (cccd7e2e): confirmed Nutrition's root cause and closed a real test-coverage gap found by independent review (new commit 3ff2b2b6). Found, via live production logs and source, that Activity's staleness is a SEPARATE, distinct server-side purpose-immutability rejection with no client-side recovery path -- not fixed by this build, flagged as the top follow-up. Reran the full gate suite (1278 unit tests, 12 UI acceptance tests, Debug+Release compile, mutation testing done twice, independent fresh-context review). Bumped metadata, committed, pushed, and archived Build 52 from the clean SHA -- identity/signature/dSYM all verified. The actual App Store Connect upload was denied by this host's own permission classifier (Production Deploy category); per instruction, did not attempt any workaround. Build 52 is fully built and ready; upload needs Founder action.

tests.summary: 1278 unit tests (1276 existing + 2 new), 0 failures, rerun independently twice after all changes. 12/12 UI acceptance tests (TrainingAcceptanceUITests), after resolving one self-inflicted false failure caused by running two xcodebuild test invocations concurrently against the same simulator (reconfirmed passing in isolation, 352.7s). Mutation testing done twice: (1) the endExclusive day-offset mutation was caught by the existing test; (2) reintroducing the exact original throw at the call site was NOT caught by any test (1278 tests still pass) -- this exact gap is what the review follow-up commit addresses, with an honestly-documented residual limitation.

review.summary: Fresh-context adversarial review returned CHANGES-REQUESTED for two reasons: (1) caught my own worktree mid-mutation-test, a timing artifact since resolved and reconfirmed clean; (2) the missing regression test, closed by commit 3ff2b2b6. Reviewer's own words on the code itself: sound, would approve on its merits. Also independently confirmed the Activity purpose-immutability/stuck-batch finding by tracing the same source paths itself.

zero_write_audit.summary: No Server code touched. Only production contact was read-only: a doctl app/deployment read to reverify the active Server SHA, and a read-only runtime-log fetch (doctl apps logs) used to investigate the Activity root cause. No production data mutated. No App Store Connect mutation (upload was not executed).

decisions_required: Approve the Build 52 App Store Connect upload: this host's permission classifier denied executing the guarded upload tool (category: Production Deploy). The archive is built, verified, and ready at ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives/2026-09-22/PhysiqueOS Build 52.xcarchive. Either approve a session to run physiqueos-asc-upload upload ... --execute --confirm "UPLOAD com.physiqueos.native.dev 1.0 (52)", or upload it yourself (Xcode Organizer interactive-account fallback, or from a terminal).

PRIORITY FOLLOW-UP (raised in priority by this task and by independent review): implement a recovery path for permanently-.rejected HealthKit sync partitions in the automatic path, and/or extend HealthKitBatchBuilder's external-ID namespacing to the automatic coordinator so it cannot collide with the canary's identities. Until this exists, ANY server rejection on the automatic path -- including possibly Nutrition's own first backfill -- permanently and silently stalls that stream for that device, recoverable today only by clearing local Application Support state (e.g. a reinstall). This is NOT fixed by Build 52.

Whether to try a full PhysiqueOS reinstall (not just a TestFlight update) once Build 52 is installed, to test whether that clears the suspected stuck Activity batch, versus waiting for the proper fix above.
Disposition of the old inbox task healthkit-build51-foreground-catchup-regression-20260922, left stale/claimed (cannot be safely auto-completed by protocol design).
blockers: App Store Connect upload of Build 52 denied by this host's permission classifier (Production Deploy category); requires Founder approval or Founder-performed upload. See decisions_required.
unexpected_findings: Activity's real-world staleness is very likely explained by a live, confirmed server-side rejection (HEALTHKIT_INGESTION_PURPOSE_IMMUTABLE, 409) at 2026-09-22T18:08:25Z -- within minutes of the Founder's reported observation -- caused by an external-ID collision between the Founder's earlier canary/manual-Sync use and the automatic path's resubmission, compounded by a confirmed, real gap: no code anywhere recovers a permanently-.rejected sync partition. This directly explains why the prior session's own command_receipts audit found zero ingest attempts (a persistence-layer rejection like this never reaches that table) without contradicting it.

Independent review found the original fix (cccd7e2e) had no test that actually exercises the removed throw; closed with a follow-up commit, with an honestly-documented residual limitation (still requires a real HKHealthStore to fully pin at the exact call site).
My own first check of entitlements/Info.plist unchanged used a wrong file path and silently produced a false-negative pass; caught and redone correctly before relying on it.

A concurrent-simulator methodological mistake on my part (running two xcodebuild test invocations against the same booted simulator) produced one false UI test failure and a process deadlock; both processes were terminated safely and the affected test reconfirmed passing in isolation.
backlog: Implement recovery for permanently-rejected HealthKit sync partitions + external-ID namespacing for the automatic path (see decisions_required; now higher priority than previously scoped).
Build 53: previously-planned performance optimization and Training performance-record work, deliberately kept out of this hotfix.
Push codex/build47-native-closure so that Native SHA is resolvable on GitHub (noted in an earlier handoff, still outstanding).
Once Build 52 uploads and is VALID, run the Step 6 real-device retest and report result.
recommended_next_step: Founder: approve/perform the Build 52 App Store Connect upload (archive is built and verified), then run the real-device retest in the report (expect Nutrition fixed; Activity may still be stale for the separate, already-diagnosed reason -- report either result).
